title: False positive: /reports/status SQL value comes from a fixed allowlist
evidence: demo-store-api/app/main.py:28 reads the user-supplied `status` key. main.py:29 maps it through the REPORT_STATUSES dict (main.py:8-12) with .get(key, "OPEN"), so `status` can only be one of the constants "OPEN", "SHIPPED" or "REFUNDED". User input never reaches the f-string at main.py:31. Any key not in the dict becomes "OPEN". No injection is possible.
recommended_fix: No security fix is required. For defense in depth, and to silence the scanner, switch to a parameterized query: conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE status = ?", (status,)). Separately, check whether this operations-dashboard endpoint should require authentication (no auth is visible).
